newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE regains 4,000 with help of bid, Dow rise.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE regains 4,000 with help of bid, Dow rise.

text.p: UK shares closed higher on Wednesday, near the best levels of the day as the stock market was revived by renewed takeover activity and sentiment improved on Wall Street.
The FTSE 100 index finished 38.6 points better at 4,018.2, regaining the 4,000 level for the first time in five days.
News that U.S. group Entergy Corp had made an agreed 1.267 billion stg bid for London Electricity helped UK shares get off to a positive start.
An overnight rally in New York also played its part and UK shares extended gains when the Dow opened higher again today.
